requirement_breaks: The implementation hashes `abi.encode(poolKey)`, which first copies the struct into a newly allocated memory buffer instead of computing the ID directly from the calldata-resident key as requested.
Because `abi.encode(poolKey)` allocates an ABI buffer in memory rather than limiting itself to scratch space, it does not meet the requested memory-discipline for this helper.
